title: Pre-commit hooks in CLAUDE.md: run via `uv run --only-group lint pre-commit` to avoid syncing the full dev environment
answers: How do I run the pre-commit hooks or lint checks on a single file in this repo?
How do I install the git pre-commit hooks for MLflow development?
Why does running pre-commit through uv take so long or install the whole dev environment?
Where in CLAUDE.md are the pre-commit and linting commands documented?
body:
Path: Contributor setup for code quality in CLAUDE.md, the "pre-commit" section: install the git hooks, run all hooks on all files, run hooks on specific files, and run a single hook (e.g. ruff) by name. Covers any request to lint, format-check, or pre-commit-run a file before committing.
Rule: Invoke pre-commit as `uv run --only-group lint pre-commit ...` (install, run, `run install-bin -a -v`, `--files`, `--all-files`, or a hook id). The `--only-group lint` flag limits the uv sync to the `lint` dependency group so uv does not install the full `dev` environment just to run the hooks. Plain `uv run pre-commit` is the older form documented before this change.
Symptom: Running pre-commit through plain `uv run` pulled in the entire development dependency set, making a simple lint run slow.
Constraints: Applies to running pre-commit hooks from the repo root. The standalone Ruff, Clint, and typo-checker commands that used to sit in a separate "Code Quality" section were removed from CLAUDE.md, so look to the pre-commit hooks for those checks rather than expecting them as standalone commands in this file.
applies: Repo-level developer guidance in CLAUDE.md for running pre-commit hooks and linting in MLflow.
says: Running local commit checks takes too long and downloads all developer dependencies.
How do I quickly run linting checks on only my modified files?
Git pre-commit hooks are syncing the full development environment instead of just linters.
Where can contributors find the updated instructions for installing and running code linters?
search: Repo-level contributor guidance in CLAUDE.md specifies invoking git pre-commit hooks and linter checks using uv run --only-group lint pre-commit ... to avoid syncing the full dev environment. This applies to hook installation, running on specific files with --files, --all-files, or specific hook IDs like ruff, avoiding the slow dependency sync of plain uv run pre-commit. Standalone commands for Ruff, Clint, and typo-checker were removed from CLAUDE.md in favor of pre-commit hooks run from the repository root.
